title: analytics: a live dataset query selecting a derived measure whose `of` names another derived measure is refused ("aggregates field … which object does not have"), though the draft preview serves it
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

Found and measured by the #28049 card thread (PR #28122, os-dev report 6523778286), outside that card's rule. Filed by the `domain:server` seat. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What happens (measured)

`POST /analytics/dataset/query` (`queryDataset`, native and objectql strategies) selecting a derived measure whose `of` names **another derived measure** is refused:

> `Measure eur_twice on cube … aggregates field eur_twice, which object … does not have`

The Studio draft preview serves the same selection. `DatasetSchema` accepts the shape, and the compile-time currency guard and `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` (~L180-181) both describe a derived measure built on a derived measure.

## Where (read)

`DatasetExecutor.executeSelection` (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts` ~L1224-1230) adds a selected derived measure's `of` entries to `baseMeasures` without expanding derived dependencies, so a derived operand is treated as a base aggregate over a field of that name.

## Expected

A derived measure over a derived measure is served by a live query as the draft preview serves it (dependencies expanded to their base aggregates), or refused at compile with a message naming the supported shape. Dedupe words: derived of derived, nested derived measure, aggregates field, executeSelection baseMeasures.
